executive_summary: Core seed-robust (ROBUST, n=3): standard 2-layer transformer solves modadd p=113 (test=0.99996±0.00006); attention-only at chance (0.0065±0.0019). Key-value retrieval: both standard and attention-only solve (1.000±0.000).

Causal ablation (ROBUST, n=3): zeroing any single component drops modadd test by Δ≈+0.91-0.99; KV layer-1 attention is the most essential single component for both tasks. eRank growth alone does not identify causal components.

Grokking geometry (ROBUST, n=3): eRank peaks at memorization, drops through grokking; same-sum ρ drops from ~1.0 to <0.1; top-5 singular mass increases; L1 Δ_MLP transitions from negative to positive.

Layer-0 freezing (PILOT, n=3 seeds, 4 variants): all 12 runs grokked. Trainable layer-0 is not necessary. Freezing slows grokking 20-90%. Compression migrates: freeze_A0_M0 -> L1 picks up more compression (Δ -2.91 vs -1.70). freeze_A0 -> M0 picks up much more compression (Δ -8.16 vs -0.93).

Architecture-order sweep (INTERIM in seed coverage, complete in schedule coverage): 102 schedules at depths 2/3/4, single seed. 93 GROKKED, 5 MEMORIZED_ONLY, 4 FAILED_TO_FIT. First-block identity is the cleanest predictor (A-first: 48/48 grokked; M-first: 44/48). Pearson(final_rep_eRank, test_acc) = -0.866 — geometry beats ordering.
Striking single-seed control: depth4_control_AAAAAAAA (8 attention layers, no MLP) grokked at test=1.000 on modadd p=113. Contradicts the 2-layer attention-only failure. Worth multi-seed replication.

Hybrid retrieve-then-add task (FAILED / DIAGNOSTIC): p=23,m=3 plateaus at fixed-pair shortcut (~37%) for linear and FFN heads. Aux-retrieval supervision rescues to 100% with a linear head. Bottleneck is training signal, not readout.

Caveat: layer-0 freezing is the only new multi-seed result. Architecture-order and hybrid analyses are seed=0 only. Multi-seed replication of striking single-seed findings is the highest-priority next step.

recommended_slides.title: Title / research question
recommended_slides.main_message: Identifying attention vs MLP roles in tiny transformers via eRank, ablation, freezing, and architecture-order interventions.

recommended_slides.title: Method: eRank + residual-stream hooks
recommended_slides.main_message: eRank = exp(H of singular values). Δ_attn / Δ_MLP attribute representational change per component.
recommended_slides.key_eq: Δ_attn^(ℓ) = eRank(R_mid) - eRank(R_pre); Δ_MLP^(ℓ) = eRank(R_post) - eRank(R_mid)

recommended_slides.title: Core seed-robust result
recommended_slides.main_message: Modadd: standard solves, attention-only at chance. KV: both solve.

recommended_slides.title: Ablation: geometry vs causality
recommended_slides.main_message: Zeroing any single component crashes both tasks; ablation needed to identify necessity.

recommended_slides.title: Graded ablation: dose-response
recommended_slides.main_message: Necessary != fragile. Smooth degradation reveals sensitivity profiles.

recommended_slides.title: Grokking = compression + task-aligned geometry
recommended_slides.main_message: eRank drops, top-k mass rises, same-sum ρ → 0 during grokking.

recommended_slides.title: Latest result: layer-0 freezing
recommended_slides.main_message: All 12 runs grok. Trainable layer-0 is NOT necessary; freezing slows grokking 20-90%.

recommended_slides.title: Compression is mobile
recommended_slides.main_message: freeze_A0_M0 → L1 picks up compression; freeze_A0 → M0 compresses dramatically more.

recommended_slides.title: Architecture-order sweep (102 schedules)
recommended_slides.main_message: First-block identity is the cleanest binary predictor. Geometry beats ordering.
recommended_slides.key_eq: S_{A before M} = (1/d²) Σᵢ Σⱼ 1[i<j, Cᵢ=A, Cⱼ=M]

recommended_slides.title: Architecture-order: per-block eRank
recommended_slides.main_message: M-first failed schedules show Δ_MLP ≈ 0 in leading M blocks; depth-4 recovers.

recommended_slides.title: Hybrid retrieve-add: failure-mode analysis
recommended_slides.main_message: p=23 plateaus at fixed-pair shortcut; FFN head doesn't help; aux-retrieval rescues to 100%.

recommended_slides.title: Novelty, caveats, next steps
recommended_slides.main_message: Layer-0 freezing + arch-order sweep + per-block Δ_eRank are the novel angles. Multi-seed replication is the main next step.

architecture_order.key_finding: First-block identity is the cleanest binary predictor. Geometric eRank compression (Pearson -0.866) beats ordering (Pearson +0.36, Spearman 0.02).

hybrid.key_finding: FFN head doesn't help. Probes (linear ≈ MLP) show information not present in residual. Aux supervision rescues. Bottleneck = training signal, not readout.

caveats: Layer-0 freezing is the only new multi-seed result. Arch-order sweep and hybrid analyses are seed=0 only.
Architecture variants are NOT parameter-matched. Pure-A schedules have fewer parameters than mixed or pure-M.
Frozen ≠ ablated. Frozen-from-init layers remain in the forward pass with random weights.
Failed-model eRank is not successful-circuit geometry. Hybrid eRank trajectories should not be over-interpreted.
Early-layer ablations cascade downstream; single-component Δ test_acc is not easily decomposable.
Dense grokking trajectories exist only for seed 0; seeds 1, 2 have sparser sampling.
Freezing from initialization is not the same as freezing after memorization.
eRank is geometric, not causal; pair with ablation or same-sum clustering.
Hybrid task is not solved end-to-end with natural training signal — aux-retrieval rescue is a diagnostic, not a main result.
next_steps: Multi-seed the most surprising single-seed results: (a) depth4_control_AAAAAAAA replication; (b) freeze_A0 → Δ_MLP[0] = −8.16 replication.
Freeze M0 (and A0) AFTER memorization rather than from random init (the doc's flagship follow-up).
Parameter-match key arch-order variants (AAMM vs MMAA with equalized total params).
Run M1 and M2 freeze variants for comparison (symmetric to layer-0 freezing).
Test causal sufficiency of frozen-trained models via post-hoc ablation.
Treat hybrid retrieve-add as a failure-mode case study; pursue either supervision-free objectives for query-conditioned retrieval or a different task.
